item.title: Unveiling of “Scelte Future” (Future Choices), a strategic initiative for the future of new generations
item.description:
Aimed at families with children aged 0 to 6, "Scelte Future" promotes an incentivised savings, financial education and ongoing support scheme. The programme trials an asset-building model designed to reduce inequality and widen access to higher education for future generations.

L'articolo Unveiling of “Scelte Future” (Future Choices), a strategic initiative for the future of new generations proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.title: From the new GAM to a vision for the City’s development
item.description:
More than a regeneration project, the new GAM is an investment in the ability of cultural institutions to create value for their communities. A project that reflects the vision of Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo by bringing together heritage preservation, innovation and local development.

item.title: UN Secretary-General’s Scientific Advisory Board meets in Turin
item.description:
The meeting of the UN Secretary-General’s Scientific Advisory Board (SAB), held in Turin on 25–26 June 2026, marks a key milestone in Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo’s strategic positioning, reflecting its commitment to making internationalisation a cross-cutting pillar of its strategy for the local area.

L'articolo UN Secretary-General’s Scientific Advisory Board meets in Turin proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.title: 2,800 new trees to regenerate Turin’s avenues
item.description:
Official launch of the tree-planting programme to renew Turin’s tree-lined avenues. The initiative brings together a range of partners and will involve the phased planting of new trees through to 2030, alongside the introduction of a scientific monitoring system to evaluate their impact on public health, air quality and the city’s resilience to climate change.

L'articolo 2,800 new trees to regenerate Turin’s avenues proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.title: Two new early diagnosis machines at IRCCS Candiolo
item.description:
Cutting-edge equipment for the advanced diagnosis of gastrointestinal cancers has been delivered to the Turin hospital. The project, made possible by “Alba dei Campioni” with support from Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo, enhances the Institute’s diagnostic capabilities by integrating advanced imaging with artificial intelligence, enabling earlier and more accurate diagnoses.

L'articolo Two new early diagnosis machines at IRCCS Candiolo proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.description:

item.title: JUST EVOLVE – Evolving language for cultural change
item.description:
The global “JUST EVOLVE” initiative encourages us to reflect on the power of words and how language can either promote or block inclusion. It is a call to challenge stereotypes and harmful representations of people with disabilities, fostering a culture that honours the dignity and worth of every individual.

L'articolo JUST EVOLVE – Evolving language for cultural change proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.title: VitalMatch Accelerator: Turin, a hub for innovation in sports and wellness
item.description:
A new acceleration programme for Sports and Wellness start-ups is set to strengthen Turin’s innovation ecosystem by combining technology, prevention and longevity. Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo, one of the ecosystem partners of VitalMatch, recognises the programme as an important tool for supporting long-term development in the region.

L'articolo VitalMatch Accelerator: Turin, a hub for innovation in sports and wellness proviene da Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo.

item.title: Sustainability: the Foundation’s impact-driven, systemic approach
item.description:
For several years, the Turin-based philanthropic organisation has translated sustainability into concrete daily actions. Every initiative, from digital communications to office management, is designed to reduce environmental impact, foster inclusion and encourage social responsibility, turning strategic principles into tangible results.
